data.title: STOCKS | ICE: Diesel net long positions rise by 3,465 contracts to 93,533
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) said that for the week of September 8, speculators' net long positions in diesel increased by 3,465 contracts to 93,533 contracts.

data.title: Arizona, Pennsylvania Election Officials Ban Workers From Prediction Market Contracts
data.description: According to CNBC, election and county officials in Arizona and Pennsylvania are barring employees from participating in prediction market contracts tied to elections, citing concerns that workers with access to ballots could use non-public information. Maricopa County supervisor Thomas Galvin said the county adopted a July resolution covering about 13,000 employees and that Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs signed an executive order banning state workers from insider trading on prediction markets. Delaware County, Pennsylvania, also banned roughly 2,200 employees from trading on election-linked prediction market contracts, while Maryland's elections administrator asked the state prosecutor in July to investigate whether such contracts violate state law. Officials said prediction market odds can be confused with polling, and Kalshi and Polymarket said they have taken steps to prevent insider trading on their platforms.

data.title: China To Raise Visa Fees For Japanese Citizens Sevenfold
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, China will raise visa application fees for Japanese citizens by roughly sevenfold on Monday, the country's embassy in Japan said Friday. The move comes in response to a similar increase by Tokyo earlier this year.

data.title: Verisk Analytics Seen As Attractive After 21% Year-To-Date Selloff
data.description:
According to CNBC, Verisk Analytics is being viewed as a stronger business than its recent stock performance suggests, with the shares down about 21% this year and 34% over the past 12 months. The Jersey City-based company generated about $3.1 billion in revenue last year, more than 80% of it recurring, and has EBITDA margins above 50% and client retention above 95%.

The article says Verisk serves the top 100 U.S. property and casualty insurers and 18 of the top 25 global reinsurers, and that its products are central to underwriting and claims work. It also notes that growth slowed to roughly 5% to 6% over the past year from a historical pace of about 8% annually, while investors have worried that AI could disrupt the business. Verisk, which named Lee Shavel CEO in 2022 after shedding non-insurance businesses, is developing its own AI tools for customers.

data.title: First-Ever Alien Terrorist Removal Court Case Ends With Afghan National Deportation
data.description: According to Axios, the Justice Department said Friday that Nazira Haji Zada, an Afghan national and lawful permanent resident, has been deported after becoming the first-ever case before the federal Alien Terrorist Removal Court. Chief Judge Joan Ericksen ordered Zada's removal in an August 20 order that was recently unsealed, and the DOJ said it used classified information to establish that Zada was an alien terrorist. The government accused Zada of assisting her son and son-in-law's foiled 2024 shooting plot, while her lawyers argued the case violated her due process rights and that they were being kept in the dark about the evidence. Attorney General Todd Blanche called the outcome a win for national security and the rule of law. The DOJ filed the first application in the court's history in July, and an unclassified summary said Zada was an ISIS supporter who backed the conspiracy.

data.title: Henrik Lundqvist Reflects on 9/11 at Cantor Fitzgerald Charity Day
data.description: Romaine Bostick spoke with former New York Rangers goalie Henrik Lundqvist at Cantor Fitzgerald's Charity Day, where the conversation focused on remembering those who died in the September 11 attacks 25 years ago, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Japan Survey Finds Over 20% Of Young People Do Not Plan To Marry
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, a Japanese government survey released Friday found that the share of young people in Japan who say they have no intention of ever marrying topped 20% for the first time. The survey also showed that the desired number of children continued to decline.

data.title: Fed Chair Warsh Faces Rate-Hike Pressure After Hot CPI
data.description:
Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh faces pressure to raise interest rates at next week’s policy meeting after a closely watched inflation report showed US consumer prices rose last month, according to Bloomberg.

The report added to expectations for action at the Fed’s upcoming meeting.

data.title: Ethereum Reaches $2,600 for First Time in Seven Months After Core CPI Eases
data.description:
Ethereum reached $2,600 for the first time in seven months on Friday. According to NS3.AI, the move came after core CPI fell to its lowest level in over five years.

Spot ETH ETFs had recorded $19.30 million in net outflows through Thursday, while Friday data remained pending.

data.title: U.S. Considers Using DPA to Boost Domestic Refining Capacity
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the United States is considering how to use the Defense Production Act to boost domestic refining capacity, and officials have not made a final decision.

data.title: STOCKS | Hut 8 Shares Rise 11.03% as Senate Clarity Act Vote Nears
data.description:
Hut 8 shares traded 11.03% higher at $100.59 as investors reacted to optimism around an upcoming Senate vote on the Clarity Act. According to NS3.AI, Senator Cynthia Lummis said the bill's updated text reflected bipartisan work over August.

Hut 8 also reported $74.9 million in second-quarter 2026 revenue, up 81% year-over-year.

data.title: Polymarket LoL Match Submarket Odds Drop 25%
data.description: A Polymarket submarket tied to the LoL playoff match between GIANTX and Natus Vincere saw the probability of the “both teams kill a dragon” outcome fall sharply from 50% one hour earlier to 25%, according to Catcher Predict monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 25% swing in the market and was attributed to the impact of breaking news.

data.title: Dormant Whale Moves 116,490 HYPE Tokens From CEX After 119 Days
data.description: A whale that had been dormant for 119 days transferred 116,490 HYPE tokens from a centralized exchange a few minutes ago. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the transfer was monitored by OnchainLens on September 12, and the tokens were worth about $9.6 million.

data.title: TLT Sees Heavy Options Volume as Long-Term Treasury Yields Rise
data.description: According to CNBC, the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF, TLT, drew about 1.6 million option contracts on Thursday, nearly double its average daily volume, as 30-year U.S. Treasury yields rose another 7.6 basis points. The 856,750 put contracts traded were about 3.3 times the average, with the most active contract the October 79 put at 123,649 contracts and an average price of $0.4786 per contract. One of the largest trades was an October 80/79 put spread that traded 65,000 contracts for a net debit of $0.275 per spread, a nearly $1.8 million bet that TLT will fall below the $80 strike by October expiration. TLT closed at $80.78 after hitting an intraday 52-week low of 80.665.

data.title: U.S. Senate Warren Questions Bessent Over Russian Foreign Minister’s Attendance at U.S.-Hosted G20 Meeting
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Senator Warren sent a letter to Treasury Secretary Bessent questioning why Russia's foreign minister attended the recent G20 meeting hosted by the United States.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis Seize Territory Near Bab Al-Mandab Strait
data.description: According to the BBC, Yemen's Houthis have seized territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a key route for oil shipments and global shipping. The strait links the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and is one of the world's most important maritime chokepoints.

data.title: Crypto-Linked Equities Rise Ahead of Senate Vote on Clarity Act
data.description:
BitMine Immersion shares rose 4.46% to $25.28 Friday afternoon as crypto-linked equities advanced. According to NS3.AI, the move came amid optimism over U.S. digital asset regulatory legislation.

Investor expectations increased ahead of an upcoming Senate vote on the Clarity Act. Ether traded at $2,570 Friday afternoon.

data.title: U.S. Commerce Secretary Lutnick Says U.S. Could “Generate Revenue” From Trump’s Proposed $5,000 Cash Checks
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said the United States could try to “generate revenue” from the $5,000 cash checks proposed by U.S. President Donald Trump, and that the fiscal cost would not rely on taxes.

data.title: STOCKS | CleanSpark Shares Jump More Than 7% as Bitcoin Rebounds Toward $79,000
data.description:
CleanSpark shares rose more than 7% on Friday as Bitcoin rebounded toward $79,000. According to NS3.AI, Benzinga Pro data showed the stock up 8.77% at $13.03 at publication.

Bitcoin moved nearly 4% within two hours as traders weighed hotter-than-expected August inflation data and its possible impact on a September interest-rate decision.

data.title: Steven Adler Can Continue False Claims Act Suit Against The Sporn Company
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Steven Adler, a former consultant turned whistleblower, can continue his False Claims Act lawsuit accusing The Sporn Company Inc. and others of defrauding the U.S. government by importing jewelry from Canada without paying proper duties. The U.S. District Court for Vermont, Chief Judge Christina Reiss, denied a motion to dismiss, saying The Sporn Company failed to show that its $172,845 settlement reached in 2023 was an alternative remedy under the False Claims Act that would bar Adler's suit. The court also rejected the defendants' claim that it lacked jurisdiction, saying the U.S. Court of International Trade does not have jurisdiction over False Claims Act whistleblower lawsuits.
